`abstract class RenderBridge`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IRenderBridge`](/reference/bridges/irenderbridge/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`GlRenderBridge`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/), [`VulkanRenderBridge`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanrenderbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [RenderBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/RenderBridge.java)

The base class of a render bridge, which keeps the matrices, the render state and the frame in Java and leaves the GPU calls to its subclass.

## Description

A subclass implements the clears, `drawPrimitive` and the three `create...` methods, and calls `requireFrame()` before it touches the GPU in a frame.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-beginFrame"></a>

### beginFrame

`void beginFrame()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The JOID frame has already begun, call endFrame() first

Marks the frame as begun and calls `beginFrameCommands()`.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when a frame is already begun.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-endFrame"></a>

### endFrame

`void endFrame()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Calls `submitFrameCommands()` and marks the frame as ended.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no frame is begun.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-beginFrameCommands"></a>

### beginFrameCommands

`void beginFrameCommands()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it at each `beginFrame()`; it does nothing by default.
Override it to start recording the commands of a frame, or to save the state of a host.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-submitFrameCommands"></a>

### submitFrameCommands

`void submitFrameCommands()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it at each `endFrame()`, even when the frame failed; it does nothing by default.
Override it to submit the commands of the frame, or to give a host its state back.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-clearDepthBuffer"></a>

### clearDepthBuffer

`void clearDepthBuffer()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it from `clearDepth()`.
Clear the depth of the current target to `1`, with depth writes on.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-clearStencilBuffer"></a>

### clearStencilBuffer

`void clearStencilBuffer()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it from `clearStencil()`, only when the window is the target.
Clear the stencil to `0`, with every bit writable.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-clearColorBuffer"></a>

### clearColorBuffer

`void clearColorBuffer(float red, float green, float blue, float alpha)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it from `clearColor`, only while color writes are on.
Clear the color of the current target to that color.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-drawPrimitive"></a>

### drawPrimitive

`void drawPrimitive(Primitive primitive, VertexBuffer buffer, IShader shader)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it from `draw` with a shader that is active and a buffer that is not empty.
Apply the whole current state, bind the samplers of the shader and draw the vertices; call `requireFrame()` first.

<a id="RenderBridge-method-requireFrame"></a>

### requireFrame

`void requireFrame()` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no frame is begun, with the message that the render contract expects.
